name: kb-writer
description: Work on KB tickets and intent workspaces from Claude. Check status, update plans, review drafts, and publish articles.

KB_WRITER_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: KB Writer access token
KB_WRITER_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Personal access token (kbw_pat_...) from KB Writer -> avatar menu -> Claude Plugin Setup. Pasting it here stores it in your OS keychain; the install script instead writes it to pluginConfigs in your user settings.
